level.name: Wedding Gift Thief
level.hook: A cash envelope disappeared from the wedding gift box. Someone here took it
level.truth: A cash envelope disappeared from the wedding gift box. Jack took it. Leo is Lily's younger brother and sits at the open end of the bride's family row beside Paul. Zoe, wearing red glasses, sits directly behind Leo. Dan is the official photographer and Rose is the wedding planner; together they occupy the two spots around the camera tripod, with Rose to Dan's right. Zoe and Nina are Lily's university friends, and Max is questioning Nina about the missing envelope. After Nina is placed, she quietly warns May. Rose and May are both reacting to Jack; their two reaction directions are required to locate Jack's position. When Jack is placed, a wedding cash envelope becomes visible with him and exposes the theft. Only after this reveal does Amy's clue open; Amy was assigned to help watch the gift box and is the final placement.

art.backgroundDescription: Reuse the Sample Wedding ceremony scene: floral arch at the front, central aisle, left and right guest seating, camera tripod near the lower-middle area, and a wedding gift box near the lower-right/bottom area.
art.tone: Warm wedding scene with light social mystery and comic drama
art.artistNote: Reuse the existing Sample Wedding composition as much as possible. Replace the old flower-basket gameplay landmark with a clear WEDDING GIFT BOX. Dan and Rose must read as the two characters positioned on opposite sides of the CAMERA TRIPOD. Reaction readability is critical: Rose must clearly look toward Jack after placement, Nina must clearly whisper/look toward May, and May must clearly glare toward Jack. Rose + May reaction directions must visually converge on Jack's slot. Do not give Amy any pre-reveal visual detail that associates her with the Gift Box. Jack's stolen envelope must NOT be visible before his correct placement. In Jack's reaction asset, reveal a cash/wedding envelope partly sticking out of his pocket or bag as visual proof. Amy is solved only after Jack's reveal.
art.referenceNote: Based directly on the Tool's Sample Wedding scene and character positions.

ending.imageBrief: At the wedding, Jack has just been exposed near the front-right guest area with a wedding cash envelope visibly sticking out of his pocket or bag. Rose the wedding planner and May are both glaring toward him. Lily and Noah react in shock/anger, while the gift box and wedding seating remain visible.

characters.artistNote: Reuse groom design. React toward Jack when the theft is exposed.

characters.name: Lily
characters.artistNote: Reuse bride design. React in shock/anger when Jack is exposed.

characters.name: Tom

characters.name: Max
characters.role: Guest helping ask about the missing envelope
characters.artistNote: From START, Max is visibly questioning/looking directly toward Nina's truth slot. This reuses the Initial State vocabulary learned in L007.

characters.name: Leo
characters.artistNote: Opening character. Keep him visually plausible as Lily's younger brother.

characters.name: Amy
characters.role: Guest helping with the wedding gift box
characters.artistNote: Amy is the final cleanup placement after Jack is exposed. Before the reveal, do not give her any visual prop or outfit detail that links her to the gift box. Her connection to the gift box should only be introduced by the post-reveal clue.

characters.name: Dan
characters.artistNote: Camera must be obvious. Opening character beside the camera tripod.

characters.name: Rose
characters.artistNote: After correct placement, Rose becomes suspicious and clearly looks toward Jack's truth slot. This reaction is GAMEPLAY evidence.

characters.name: Nina
characters.artistNote: After correct placement, Nina quietly warns/whispers toward May. Reaction must clearly point upward toward May's truth slot.

characters.name: May
characters.artistNote: After correct placement, May clearly glares toward Jack. This reaction combines with Rose's reaction to identify Jack.

characters.name: Jack
characters.artistNote: Do NOT show the stolen envelope in tray/base state. In M07_R01, Jack becomes sweaty/nervous and a wedding cash envelope becomes visibly exposed from his pocket or bag.
